'''Lonndar Eadwinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as an implant researcher during the [[Third Galactic War]], visiting both [[Carrick Station]]<ref name="TOR" /> and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|Imperial Fleet}}</ref>
